messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a small console UI deploy at 14:30 PT into the canary slot (10% traffic) for v3.4.1. Goal: fix asset fingerprinting and a minor chart rendering glitch. ETA ~30m for canary verification. @maya can you run the smoke checklist at ~14:55? :calendar:

maya: Ack. I'll run the quick smoke — login, main dashboard, and a few heavy pages. I can post a short pass/fail and a couple of curl checks. Also, is there an explicit CDN invalidation window or do we prefer targeted purge after canary?

connor: I'll be on rollback. Rollback plan: cut traffic, tag rollback v3.4.0, redeploy frontend, then re-run CDN purge for the older assets. Can do that within ~10m if needed.

deploy-bot: Automated canary launch: canary_id=ci-1808129876, strategy=10pct->100pct, status=rolling, started_by=alex

maya: Quick smoke results (14:56 PT): login ✅, dashboard load ✅, charts render mostly fine but noticed one missing stylesheet (404) at /assets/css/console-theme.css on the canary host. Captured headers:

```
$ curl -I https://canary-console.internal/assets/css/console-theme.css
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 21:56:12 GMT
```

Seems like the fingerprint is different compared to current prod. Not a functional blocker (layout mostly OK) but worth fixing before full rollout.

alex: Thanks — stepping canary back to 0 while we investigate so prod isn't affected. @connor can you confirm rollback gating and standby?

connor: Confirmed. I'll hold the rollback window and be ready to cut traffic. If we re-run the deploy we should ensure the build artifact has the correct asset manifest. Also recommend issuing a targeted CDN purge for the new fingerprint if we push again.

maya: Found build id on canary: build-20260317-7f3a. The asset in the bundle is console-theme.7f3a.css but the request was for console-theme.css — looks like a missing rewrite rule. Posting webpack excerpt: 

```
// webpack config snippet
output: {
  filename: '[name].[contenthash].js',
  publicPath: '/assets/'
}
```

Possibly the server that serves non-fingerprinted paths isn't mapping to the fingerprints.

alex: Good catch. While we patch server rewrite, two options: 1) rebuild with non-hashed filenames (not ideal), 2) run targeted purge + warm cache and re-enable canary after server rewrite deploy. I prefer option 2 if we can guarantee correct mapping. Connor?

connor: Option 2 works: we can deploy a tiny nginx rewrite fix to map /assets/css/console-theme.css -> /assets/css/console-theme.*.css for a short window. I'll prep that change and hold the rollback button. If deploy goes wrong we revert the nginx change and roll back the frontend.

alex: Connor, can you push the nginx patch to canary infra and I will re-trigger the canary roll. Maya, once the canary is back, please re-run the same curl and UI checks.

connor: Patch pushed to canary infra at 15:14 PT. Restarting canary with same build id for validation.

deploy-bot: Canary update: canary_id=ci-1808129876, action=restart_with_infra_patch, status=rolling

maya: Re-checking (15:16 PT): curl now shows 200 for the css:

```
$ curl -I https://canary-console.internal/assets/css/console-theme.css
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/css
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 22:16:38 GMT
ETag: "7f3a"
```

UI check: login ✅, dashboard ✅, charts ✅. No console errors on quick smoke.

alex: Great. Let's run a CDN targeted invalidation for the fingerprinted css pattern to be safe, then proceed to incremental rollout. Maya — can you execute the purge? Connor, standby for rollback for 30m after full rollout.

maya: Running Fastly purge for regex '/assets/css/console-theme.*' now. Command:

```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Fastly-Key: $FASTLY_KEY" \
  https://api.fastly.com/service/SRV_CONSOLE/purge/regex \
  -d '/assets/css/console-theme.*'
```

Response: {"status":"ok","id":"purge-87421"} :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: CDN purge queued: purge_id=purge-87421, state=queued

maya: Waiting 30s to let edge propagate, re-checking assets... all css 200, load times normal.

alex: Proceeding to ramp: 10% -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (20m) once metrics look good. I'll post when we hit each milestone. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

connor: Watching error rates and latency. I have rollback steps ready in the runbook if we see >0.5% 5xx or latency >1500ms p95 on critical routes.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 10pct -> 50pct at 15:35 PT, metrics nominal.

maya: Final smoke after 50% pass. No regressions seen.

alex: 100% complete at 15:50 PT. Closing deploy. Will follow up in release notes with the nginx rewrite as a short-term mitigation and tracking ticket to fix asset rewrite properly in the build. Thanks all.

connor: Added rollback note to release checklist and monitoring dashboard watchlist.

maya: Noted. Posting a short post-mortem link once I create the ticket for proper asset mapping.

alex: Great work team. :rocket:
